reason: Spinously muricate means muricate with spiny outgrowths. Plain muricate loses the spines.
Tetrangular means four-angled, which is quadrangular.
The word means unequal in width. The target is unequal size in general, so the width is lost.
Unifacial describes leaves, such as bifacial and unifacial leaves. It does not describe other parts.
Unveined means no veins. PO lists vein as a synonym of vascular bundle.
Windowed means having translucent window-like openings. Fenestrated is the closest match.
Without red colour means not red.
Without stereids means stereid absent.
Abruptly rounded is a specific apex shape. Obtuse (roundish) loses the abruptness.
Aerolate is a misspelling of areolate.
Broad-rhomboidal is rhomboid. The modifier is a minor loss.
Wedge-shaped is a PATO synonym of cuneate.
Central strand is a moss stem structure. As a noun phrase in a description it means the strand is present.
Complex spirals describes spiral phyllotaxis, so spirally arranged fits.
Compounded means made of several leaflets or units. That is not lobed, because lobes are not separate units.
A crust is a lichen or algal growth form. It is not the same as a mat-forming habit.
Cupulelike is cup-like, a PATO synonym of cup-shaped.
Decolorous means without colour.
Echlorophyllose means lacking chlorophyll. The target is colourless in general, and the bearer would be wrong. Chlorophyll absent would fit better.
Eperistomate means without a peristome.
Erecto-spreading mixes erect and spreading. Semi erect only partly covers it.
Growing in dense mats means mat-forming.
Intensely coloured means strong colour saturation.
Long-rhomboidal is rhomboid. The modifiers are a minor loss.
Lacking red pigment means not red.
Lawn-forming is the same habit as mat-forming.
Laxly disposed means loosely arranged.
Leptodermous means thin-walled. The thinness belongs to the wall, not to the bearer. The bearer should be the cell wall.
Flexuose means wavy or sinuous.
Lusterless means dull.
A mitten shape has one lateral lobe, like a thumb. It is not two-lobed.
Moderately tall is mid-range height. Increased height means taller than normal.
Moderately thick is mid-range thickness. Increased thickness means thicker than normal.
Narrow-rhomboidal is rhomboid. The modifier is a minor loss.
Non-erose means not erose.
Pellucid means translucent, so non-pellucid means not translucent.
Non-sinuose means not sinuous.
Not distorted means not deformed.
Not sinuose means not sinuous.
Striolate means finely striate, so not striolate means not striated.
Rostrate means beaked. Short and oblique are lost, but beaked still holds.
Orderly means arranged in a regular pattern.
Perigonial is an adjective, as in perigonial bud or leaf. It does not say that a perigonial bract is present.
Protonematous means having a protonema, the filament stage. A protonemal rhizoid is a different structure. The target should be a protonema present.
Pubescent and glandulose together are glandular-pubescent.
Readily disintegrating means fragile.
Rhizoautoicous is rhizautoicous, a specific kind of autoicous. FLOPO_0991295 exists, and the parent autoicous term is too broad.
Rhizoid-bearing means rhizoids are present.
Scabrose is a variant spelling of scabrous.
Short- to long-rectangular is rectangular. The length range is lost, which is minor.
